mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates and boosts forward S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and non-farm payrolls indicates broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline month-over-month, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive policy action that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances during tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts relative to their 12-month moving average indicate robust consumer demand for housing and related sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real GDP and industrial production indicates severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days due to heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline quarter-over-quarter, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market slowdown regimes, non-farm payrolls declining below -0.5% monthly growth signals weakening employment conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances during slowdown regimes when PAYEMS MoM growth is below -0.5, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03.
